title: Rep. Thomas Kean Jr. Disclosed 3 Stock Sales Including Microsoft ($15K-$50K)
content:
Rep. Thomas Kean Jr. (NJ-7) disclosed three stock sales on November 19, 2026, all dated October 27: Microsoft in the $15,001–$50,000 band, plus Stryker and Johnson & Johnson at $1,001–$15,000 each.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Nov 23 (Bargo est.)
Oct 27JNJJohnson & JohnsonSale, $1,001–$15,000$268.73 vs. $270.05 (+0.49%)
Oct 27MSFTMicrosoft CorporationSale, $15,001–$50,000$531.33 vs. $492.50 (−7.31%)
Oct 27SYKStryker CorporationSale, $1,001–$15,000$301.42 vs. $316.15 (+4.89%)

Transaction date for all three: Oct 27, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 19, 2026 (23 days later). Member: Rep. Thomas H. Kean Jr., NJ-7 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Largest sale: Microsoft (MSFT), $15,001–$50,000, on October 27.
  • Two smaller sales: Stryker (SYK) and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), $1,001–$15,000 each, the same day.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Microsoft about 7.3% lower on November 23 than at the sale date, Stryker about 4.9% higher and Johnson & Johnson about 0.5% higher.
  • Timing: the filing came 23 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
23 days after the trades, which were all dated October 27. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 23 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
